references.text: David asks for healing and points to God's ability to heal.
The prophet Habakkuk speaks about living by faith, which can be seen in connection with faith in Jesus' healing power.
A similar event where Jesus heals a synagogue leader's daughter.
Luke's version of the event with Jairus' daughter, showing Jesus' power to heal and raise from the dead.
Peter raises Tabitha from the dead by praying and laying hands on her, demonstrating the apostles' ability to perform miracles in Jesus' name.
Paul heals Publius' father by laying hands on him, showing the continued effect of healing through faith in Jesus.
